research_synthesize.summary: Most transport system rollouts overrun, and data quality is the most cited cause, though scope growth also matters.

findings.statement: 64% of the 120 TMS rollouts surveyed finished later than planned.
Master data problems were the most common cause of delay, cited by 41% of teams.
Standardising carrier data before go-live was linked to 30% fewer post-launch defects.
Scope changes were behind 35% of overruns in one study.
Data quality seems to matter more than configuration for realising savings.

disagreements: How much of the delay is data versus scope growth.
openQuestions: Whether the pattern holds for small teams.
